clean_task.detail: An independently authored dense GEMM task ran through the typed container Provider in the digest-pinned gcc 13.2.0 image under an exclusive allocation. The blocked candidate reproduced its own naive baseline exactly, held the scaling and additivity identities to 1.0e-15, passed undefined-behaviour/bounds and address sanitizer runs, and beat the baseline by 3.634x or more across four alternating warm replays against a 1.05x gate. No imported attachment executed.

provider_portability.detail: Provider independence was established by withdrawing the incumbent ari.provider.coding and re-offering the identical capability contracts under the reserved stand-in identity ari.provider.synthetic-substitute. All 4 capabilities the incumbent had won rebound, deterministically, and none stayed bound to the incumbent. No second implementation was executed, so this is not cross-Provider portability: it shows only that the requirement set names capabilities rather than a Provider. The report is stored beside this file as evidence/hpc_gemm_optimization.abstraction.json.
